description: Second pass review of stoa-2xeks after fixes from first iteration.
notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — The P0 (REQUIRETLS flag dropped) means the server lies to submitters: it accepts REQUIRETLS contract but does not enforce it downstream. This will generate a user bug report the first time someone sends a REQUIRETLS message and the downstream hop does not support it. The P1 cache invalidation gap is a correctness hole that only manifests during mid-TTL policy changes, which are rare but possible.
Confidence: 80% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: the NXDomain/NoRecordsFound distinction depends on hickory's exact error variant names which I could not runtime-verify. Uncertainty driven by: not being able to run the test suite; hickory ProtoErrorKind variant naming conventions. Would raise confidence if: cargo test passes clean and the hickory resolver error types are confirmed against current hickory source.
title: Review iteration 2: MTA-STS/REQUIRETLS/STARTTLS
